findings.problem: AT07 Mixed-policy bounded settlement has primaryTask SP10.2 (Demonstrate independent private continuation). Those titles are inverted relative to the cases: mixed-policy atomicity belongs with composition operators / atomic synchronization (SP10.1 or SP10.3, or SP08.2 batch boundaries); private eligibility/disclosure belongs with private continuation (SP10.2) plus SP10.1 only if it is truly an operator. findings.neededChange: Reassign AT07.primaryTask to SP10.1 or SP10.3 (or SP08.2 if batch settlement stays in DeFi libraries). Reassign AT08.primaryTask to SP10.2. Align AS06/AS08/AS10.tasks with those owners.
